query: Our notes say: 'build an AI tool for case search', 'monthly statistics report', 'pilot of e-filing kiosks running since March, nobody funds it'. Triage these.
expected_behavior: Splits the AI tool into a problem and a solution and routes both to the idea inventory (the problem as observed, the solution as raw)
Routes the monthly report as an ongoing operational item to the work inventory
Flags the kiosk pilot as a Shadow Operation and asks for a sponsor and owner decision
Presents a recap table and waits for confirmation before saving the triage log

query: Add 'migrate the document templates' as a work package under the case-search project.
expected_behavior: Checks that the parent project exists in the work inventory or asks to onboard it first
Asks for a deliverable and due date
Routes to the Work mode of developing-and-managing-strategy with a Parent Work ID rather than creating a stand-alone project

query: The director approved the kiosk pilot. Log it.
expected_behavior: Treats it as Approved with a sponsor but asks who the owner is and whether capacity exists
If capacity is not confirmed, routes it as a decision gate flagged Capacity unconfirmed, not as committed work
Does not create records and saves only the triage log after confirmation

query: Here are 15 notes from our meeting. Sort them out.
expected_behavior: Summarizes what it understood in one table and asks only about unclear items
Asks at most two questions per turn with a recommended default
Waits for confirmation before saving the triage log

query: Registry clerks keep telling us case search is too slow.
expected_behavior: Classifies it as a Problem, not a Solution, and asks who is affected and how often
Routes it to Ideas mode with the problem starting at state observed
Does not propose a fix as part of the problem record

query: Two of our clerks want to take a records management course next quarter.
expected_behavior: Classifies it as Training, not a project
Routes it to managing-team-skills-and-allocation as a learning assignment or growth interest
Asks whether funding or a deliverable is involved and, if so, flags Funding request and adds an idea rather than creating work

query: We need funding for a new e-filing kiosk. A director likes it.
expected_behavior: Classifies it as a Solution with a Funding request flag and splits out the underlying problem
Records the sponsor but notes no owner or capacity, so it is not committed
Routes it to Ideas first and says what is needed before it can be scored; does not jump to Score or Work

query: Leadership has to choose between the vendor platform and building in-house. Also WORK-012 is blocked on the privacy assessment.
expected_behavior: Splits two rows: a Decision and a Blocker
Routes the decision to Roadmap as a decision gate and the blocker to Work as Blocked on WORK-012
Writes only the triage log

query: We were allowed a temporary workaround for the intake form until March because of the court rule change.
expected_behavior: Classifies it as an Exception, not a project
Routes it to Update mode as a dispensation with an expiry date and remediation trigger

query: The court rules changed last month and now require e-service by March.
expected_behavior: Classifies it as a Driver (a pressure), not a project or a strategy change
Routes it to Update mode as a DRV-X entry in register 01 with source and date
Asks whether it exposes an unsolved need and offers to log a Problem or Opportunity separately

query: We assume central IT will fund the licence, and policy requires a privacy impact assessment.
expected_behavior: Splits two rows: an Assumption and a Constraint
Routes both to Update mode (register 06 strategy sections) and notes dependent risks and work as follow-ups
Does not create a risk automatically

query: A new analyst starts in January and one of our leads is going on leave.
expected_behavior: Classifies both as Team change
Routes them to managing-team-skills-and-allocation, not to work or ideas

query: Follow up with finance about the invoice. Also WORK-012 is now complete.
expected_behavior: Treats the follow-up as an Action item and does not create a record
Treats WORK-012 complete as a Status update, skips triage and hands it to Work mode
Writes only the triage log, and only if there is anything to log
